_comment: WORLD Stormwood table, row stormwood_glass_for_bryn. One world-scoped delivery of ordinary Stormglass and Conductor Vine to Warden-Elect Bryn repairs the rod crew's shelter beside the Rodline workshop. Inspecting the repaired supplies there completes the chain, and the shelter becomes a safe care point with one creature bed. The shelter adds no rod safe radius, no Surge rod flag and no Calm multiplier: Rodline Post is already a Surge safe zone and Conductor Run has no rod flag.

care.label: Rest at the Rodline Rod Shelter
